instructions_to_main_agent: Build strictly using .js files in src/ (React JavaScript syntax). Do not use TypeScript .tsx extensions.
Implement the dark app shell UI (#0B1220) for App views (Map, My Reports, Incident Details, Admin Dashboard, Stepper Report Flow).
Implement light background cards (#FFFFFF) for Auth Sign In / Sign Up split screen.
All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, select, tabs, links, status badges) MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='report-problem-btn').
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds on dropdowns, modals, floating top bars, or headers without a backdrop blur blur-md or solid bg.
Use Lucide-React icons for category icons and navigation items.
Ensure status badge colors strictly follow the provided status_badges color dictionary.
